constraints.statement: The Matrix custom-event namespace is already `m.parrot.*` (task/result/status/feedback) with STATE events agent_card/channel/tunnel, and FEAT-195 explicitly rejected m.parrot.* pub/sub as the primary communication path.
constraints.implication: The Matrix carrier must extend the existing namespace (no `ai.parrot.*`), keep a human-readable body, and either route FEAT-463's tunnels through the protocol engine or justify a parallel path; room state is the natural blackboard backend.

constraints.statement: AgentRegistry is name+tag keyed and consumed by result_agent, studio_runtime, handlers/agents/data, bot factory tools and CLI loaders; PBAC policy collection hangs off register().
constraints.implication: Contract/kind/carrier/grant fields on BotMetadata must be additive and optional; find_capability is a new method, not a change to existing lookups.

constraints.statement: `parrot.registry.capabilities` already names a CapabilityRegistry (FEAT-070) that indexes tools/datasets by embedding with no AGENT resource type and no exact cap-id path.
constraints.implication: Either extend it (ResourceType.AGENT + exact/keyword index + locality ranking) or pick a distinct name; the <5 ms deterministic lookup of spike L-S3 cannot ride the embedding path.

constraints.statement: PBAC is enforced per tool call (PBACToolCallGuardrail, ResourceType.TOOL, first guard in ToolManager.execute_tool) and at bot resolution (agent_guard.enforce_agent_access); no capability-scoped agent-to-agent grant exists.
constraints.implication: Mounting a remote capability as a local tool inherits the caller-side gate for free; the serving side needs the caller's PermissionContext to travel in the message, and the grant must be a new deterministic config, not a policy on tools.

constraints.statement: Every existing agent-to-agent mechanism (crew hand-off, AgentTool, AgentSwarmToolkit.ask_agent, HybridDelegator, ResultRetrievalTool) is text in / text out and wakes the callee LLM; there is no performative, protocol state or reply-obligation typing anywhere.
constraints.implication: The performative layer is greenfield; existing tools become origin tools that the harness maps to acts, which is additive rather than a rewrite.

constraints.statement: Hop limiting already exists once: ask_agent propagates `hops`/`origin_session` via ContextVars and returns a `hop_limit` status; crews only have per-run max_iterations.
constraints.implication: The conversation hop budget should generalise the FEAT-463 mechanism rather than add a second counter.

constraints.statement: FEAT-710 decided telemetry uses a DEDICATED navigator-eventbus instance (Streams, publish-only, outbox); the RPC-on-bus pattern (reply_to, correlation) is not defined anywhere.
constraints.implication: An eventbus carrier is a third bus instance (or must justify sharing) and must define reply_to/correlation/idempotency itself, reusing the outbox + event_id dedup idiom.

constraints.statement: AuditLedger is append-only and KMS-signed but its entry schema is credential-centric (user_id, channel, tool, provider, key_fingerprint) and append() requires credential_material; a semantic audit ledger (TASK-4474) is being built in parallel.
constraints.implication: Per-performative audit lines need a new entry kind or a sibling ledger sharing the signer; coordinate with TASK-4474.

constraints.statement: WorkingMemory is a per-session pandas catalog; task_memory already defines artifact_id@version identity, an ArtifactStore protocol and a parquet blob tier; Arrow IPC/shared-memory exists only on the REPL worker boundary; no Polars in core.
constraints.implication: By-reference in-process passing and the blackboard `artifacts` key should reuse task_memory identity and the repl_worker shm ownership rules instead of inventing new ones; Polars (parent D6) is a new dependency.

constraints.statement: `delegate` is already the vocabulary of FEAT-590 tool-call-delegate (DelegateToolNode, LlamaCppDelegate, NeedleDelegate).
constraints.implication: The cfp origin tool needs another name or an explicit disambiguation.

constraints.statement: TraceContext (W3C) is carried by FlowContext and already propagates across an A2A hop; its class is re-exported into parrot.core.events.lifecycle from a dependency.
constraints.implication: The shared trace_id has a carrier; the local protocol only needs to thread it through envelopes and audit lines.

constraints.statement: Four partial directories exist today: AgentRegistry (local, name/tag), ToolManager._registered_agents (remote A2A cards, substring skill search), A2AMeshDiscovery (remote, skill/tag/search), MatrixCrewRegistry (per-crew roster).
constraints.implication: find_capability must be the unifying front, otherwise it becomes a fifth directory.

constraints.statement: Test baseline: 26 Matrix test modules, crew regression suites, AgentRegistry and CapabilityRegistry tests, working-memory tests inside the source tree.
constraints.implication: Regression coverage exists for every seam the spec would touch; new behaviour needs new suites, not retrofits.

new: Performative model: an enum (inform, request, query, agree, refuse, failure, cfp, propose, accept, reject, subscribe, not_understood) plus message fields performative/protocol/conversation_id/in_reply_to/sender/receivers|capability filter layered on the FEAT-746 envelope; the harness maps origin tools to acts (AgentTool/QuestionInput → request|query, a generic send tool with a small enum).

Protocol engine: per-conversation state machines for Inform, Request, Query, Contract Net and Subscribe with not_understood, timeout → failure(TIMEOUT), hop budget → failure(HOP_LIMIT), token budget; modelled after the flows FSM precedent and the ask_agent status enum.

Gating dispatcher: addressing (receivers | capability filter) → protocol state → decision-needed; inform handler registry (store / blackboard update / wake LLM when registered); wakes-per-message metric.

Capability directory: ResourceType.AGENT + exact cap-id/keyword index + locality/cost ranking exposed as AgentRegistry.find_capability; per-agent contract advertisement on the registry entry; inter-agent grant as scoped configuration enforced by the harness.

Blackboard: versioned single-writer keyed store (roster, definitions, tasks, digest, artifacts) with ACLs and subscriptions; in-process backend (successor to FlowContext.shared_data for protocol runs) and Matrix room-state backend.

Local carriers: in-process asyncio queue passing objects by reference; same-host Arrow IPC/shm reusing repl_worker transport ownership rules; navigator-eventbus carrier (dedicated instance, reply_to/correlation/idempotency/DLQ); Matrix carrier adapter over m.parrot.* events with human-readable body.
Audit: a performative entry kind for the signed ledger (or a sibling ledger sharing the signer) joined by trace_id.
